column1: 1-1|白家月和陈天中来中国留学。他们把护照、签证和入学通知书给老师，老师给他们办了学生证。老师告诉他们，下周一开始上课，先试听两周，然后在网上选课。以后如果有任何问题，都可以来找老师。|Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong came to China to study. They gave their passports, visas and admission letters to the teacher, who arranged their student cards. Classes begin next Monday. They should first try classes for two weeks, then select courses online. If they have any problems, they can ask the teacher.

2-1|李文和白家月到房东家看房子。房东要出租的是一个大房间，房租每月5500元。房间已经收拾好了，想租的话，今天就可以搬进来。这个房间不小，还很亮。小区离白家月的学校不远，离地铁站也很近，生活上很方便。白家月比较满意，他们决定再看看外边的环境。|Li Wen and Bai Jiayue visited an apartment. The landlord was renting a large room for 5,500 yuan a month. It was ready, and she could move in that day. The room was spacious and bright. The neighbourhood was near her school and the subway, making everyday life convenient. Bai was fairly satisfied, and they decided to look around outside.

2-3|昨天白家月顺利租到了合适的房子，今天李文帮她搬家。搬进去的时候，房东又向她介绍了房子里的东西，并告诉她怎么用。客厅里有椅子、沙发，还有一台大电视；厨房里有冰箱和一些做饭用的东西。不过，白家月平常在学校食堂吃，基本上不做饭。她租的房间里，除了一张床以外，还有一台空调、一张书桌和一把椅子。看完整个房子后，她觉得再去买几条毛巾就行了。|Bai successfully rented a suitable home yesterday, and Li helped her move today. The landlord explained the furnishings and how to use them. The living room had chairs, a sofa and a large television; the kitchen had a refrigerator and cooking equipment. Bai usually ate at the school canteen and hardly cooked. Her room had a bed, air conditioner, desk and chair. She thought she only needed to buy a few towels.

3-1|陈天中从学校出来，不知道怎么去花园小区，就向一位同学问路。同学告诉他，先往前走，到十字路口不要过马路，直接右转就到小区门口。正好同学也去那边，就和他一起走。陈天中说北京很大，自己还不熟悉路。同学告诉他，北京的路基本上都是正南正北、正东正西的，很好找。他也可以用手机地图，很容易就能找到目的地。不过，很多中文地名陈天中还不认识。同学说，他很快就会熟悉的。|Chen asked a student how to reach Huayuan neighbourhood. He should walk straight, avoid crossing at the crossroads and turn right to reach the entrance. The student was going that way and walked with him. Chen found Beijing large and unfamiliar. The student explained that roads generally run north–south or east–west, and phone maps help locate destinations. Chen still could not recognise many Chinese place names, but the student said he would soon become familiar with them.

4-1|陈天中发现他的手机停机了，因为没有信号，上不了网，自己也没带现金，所以买不了地铁票了。这时，一个人看他很着急，就帮他买票。陈天中很感谢他，想要他的联系方式，想把钱还给他。那个人说别客气，很高兴能帮到陈天中。|Chen's phone service was suspended. Without a signal he could not get online, and he had no cash, so he could not buy a subway ticket. A passer-by noticed his distress and helped buy one. Chen thanked him and asked for his contact details to repay him. The man said not to mention it and was glad to help.

5-1|白家月来中国至少两个月了，她习惯吃中餐，而且很喜欢中国菜。王一雪让她尝尝水煮鱼。白家月觉得这道菜看起来不像水煮鱼，更像油煮鱼。王一雪告诉她，这道菜先用水把鱼煮熟，最后再倒上辣椒油，其实只有最上面一层是油。白家月尝了以后，觉得很辣，不过非常好吃。王一雪让她多吃点儿，不要客气。|Bai had been in China for at least two months and was used to Chinese food, which she liked. Wang offered her water-boiled fish. Bai thought it looked more like oil-boiled fish. Wang explained that the fish is cooked in water, then topped with chilli oil; only the top layer is oil. Bai found it spicy but delicious. Wang encouraged her to eat more and make herself at home.

6-1|白家月给李文打电话，告诉他自己身体不舒服，发烧，一直咳嗽，还咳得很厉害。李文觉得她病得很严重，建议她赶快去医院检查。不过，白家月来中国后还没去过医院，不知道怎么在中国的医院看病。李文让她在家等一下，说马上去接她，陪她去医院，还能帮她翻译。白家月觉得，有李文陪着，她就放心多了。|Bai phoned Li because she felt unwell, had a fever and was coughing badly. Li thought it was serious and advised a hospital examination. She had not visited a hospital in China and did not know the procedure. Li asked her to wait at home; he would pick her up, accompany her and translate. His support reassured her.

7-1|昨天同事把市场调查的计划书发到王一雪的邮箱，并请她看看内容有没有需要改的地方。王一雪觉得写得不错，就是调查地点只有超市，不太够。同事说她会再加一些网店，并认真准备，按时完成任务。王一雪建议她做调查时要细心，注意了解客户真正的想法，如果遇到问题，要及时跟她联系。|A colleague emailed Wang a market-research plan and asked whether its content needed changes. Wang thought it was good, but supermarkets alone were insufficient survey locations. The colleague would add online shops, prepare carefully and finish on time. Wang advised her to be attentive, understand customers' real views and contact her promptly with problems.

8-1|安妮最近学习太紧张了，于是她给白家月打电话，想明天出去放松。安妮觉得能放松的地方都行。白家月问郊区怎么样，安妮说陈天中告诉她，下周王老师要带他们去郊区游玩。白家月又建议去爬长城，安妮觉得这是个好主意，并提醒白家月，明天是个大晴天，外出记得戴帽子。|Annie's studies had been stressful, so she phoned Bai to suggest relaxing outside tomorrow. Any relaxing place would do. Bai suggested the outskirts, but Annie said Teacher Wang would take them there next week. Bai then suggested climbing the Great Wall. Annie liked the idea and reminded her to wear a hat because tomorrow would be sunny.

9-1|白家月过生日时，李文给她买了花和巧克力。上次去超市时，他看到白家月拿起这个巧克力看了看又放下，就记住了。白家月特别感动，觉得自己不说李文也懂她，他真是个细心又浪漫的人。她说，刚认识不久，李文的幽默与耐心就很吸引她，不过当时只把他当普通朋友。如果李文没有一直找她聊天儿，他们可能就错过了。李文认为自己终于遇见了对的人，怎么能错过呢？遇见李文，白家月也觉得很幸运。|Li bought flowers and chocolate for Bai's birthday. He remembered her picking up that chocolate at the supermarket and putting it back. She was moved by his understanding, thoughtfulness and romance. His humour and patience had attracted her early on, although she initially saw him only as a friend. Without his continued conversations, they might have missed their chance. Li felt he had finally met the right person and could not let that chance pass. Bai also felt lucky to have met him.

10-1|刘明和王一雪说他在网上看到的一条信息：一个小伙子从广州去哈尔滨出差，没想到气温降到了零下二十几度，把他冻坏了。王一雪说，他一定后悔自己穿少了。刘明说这就叫南方不懂北方的冷。王一雪认为，冬天北方和南方的温度差别很大。所以，刘明建议，冬天来北方，尤其是东北，一定要提前查好目的地的天气。王一雪说，更重要的是，说什么也得穿上厚一点儿的衣服。|Liu told Wang about a young man who travelled from Guangzhou to Harbin for work. He had not expected temperatures below minus twenty degrees and was freezing. Wang thought he must regret dressing too lightly. Liu called this southerners not understanding northern cold. They noted the large winter temperature difference and advised checking destination weather before visiting the north, especially the northeast. Above all, visitors must wear thicker clothes.
